title: .tick/operators.json mapping and operator identity resolution
description:
Tracked, non-secret, merge-friendly multiplayer mapping in internal/operator (file mapping.go — do not touch telegram/ or cmd/, which other same-wave ticks own).

- Format: {"operators":{"<tk whoami name>":{"telegram":{"bot_username":"...","user_id":123}}}} — one top-level key per operator so concurrent adds merge cleanly; stable key ordering on write.
- LoadMapping/SaveMapping against <repo>/.tick/operators.json; UpsertOperator(name, channel, identity).
- ResolveOperator(name): merge repo mapping (public identity) with global ~/.tick/operator.json (credentials); credentials NEVER come from the repo file — a token-shaped field in operators.json is rejected with an error naming the file (fact A11 guard).

Test cases:
- Round-trip + upsert preserves other operators' entries; output is stable/deterministic bytes.
- Missing file → empty mapping, no error.
- Repo file containing a token-shaped string (\d+:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}) → load fails with clear error.
Run: go test -short -count=1 ./internal/operator/...
